title: cardamomum costatum
intro: Cardamomum costatum, commonly known as Wild Cardamom, is a plant species belonging to the family Zingiberaceae. It is a shrub-like plant with medicinal properties, primarily used to treat digestive issues such as nausea, indigestion, and diarrhea, thanks to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving gut health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
